description: This file implements the SocketPort class, which manages socket operations including creation, configuration, connection, listening, accepting, reading, writing, and multicast group management. It includes platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, and handles socket initialization, buffer management, and event handling within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: WinSocketInitializer
classes.description: Platform-specific helper class for initializing Windows Sockets API (Winsock) and retrieving function pointers for extended socket functions.

methods.name: ReceiveFrom
methods.description: Platform-specific function to receive data from a socket, extracting interface index information from ancillary data.

methods.name: SetNonBlocking
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: ConstructSocket
methods.description: Creates and configures a socket based on NodeId and interface parameters, handling platform-specific socket options and binding.

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Adjusts socket buffer sizes and allocates internal buffers for send/receive operations.

methods.name: WaitForOpen
methods.description: Waits for a socket to become open within a specified timeout.

methods.name: WaitForWriteComplete
methods.description: Waits for ongoing write operations to complete within a specified timeout.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for a socket to close within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Determines the current event flags for the socket, based on internal state and errors.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles socket events based on flags, triggering read, write, accept, or close operations.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into internal buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from internal buffer to the socket.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Closes the socket and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Opened
methods.description: Marks the socket as open and updates internal state.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and returns the socket handle.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and updates the remote NodeId.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Sets up the socket to listen for incoming connections.
